newsitem.title: POLAND: French CNP Assurances to up Polish insurer stake.
newsitem.headline: French CNP Assurances to up Polish insurer stake.

text.p: French insurance firm CNP Assurances SA is likely to increase its stake in Polish life insurer Polisa Zycie SA, possibly to 46.8 percent from current 26 percent, Polisa Zycie's deputy president said.

Zygmunt Kostkiewicz told Reuters CNP Assurances has received the Polish finance ministry approval to increase its stake in the firm and was now negotiating with other shareholders the purchase of their shares.

He said, however, other Polisa Zycie's 26-percent owner -- non-life insurance firm Polisa SA had a pre-emptive right to buy half of the shares which meant that if the right was exercised, CNP would increase its stake only to 36 percent.

"CNP Assurances was granted the Finance Ministry approval for the purchase and now it is negotiating with Polish shareholders...and I believe the transaction might be concluded in about a dozen days," he said.
Kostkiewicz said the shares were likely to be bought from four small companies, based in Kielce, holding jointly 28.8-percent in Polisa Zycie.
He said other company's shareholders were individuals.
